response.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT AlbumId, 1.0*SUM(Bytes)/SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), m AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mr FROM a) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(a.cnt) AS avg_track_count, AVG(a.rate - m.mr) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM a, m WHERE a.rate > m.mr
